snippets.output: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of kidney disease.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of losartan's drug class and indications.

snippets.output: The recommended dosage of losartan is typically 50-100 mg once daily.
Taking two pills of losartan at once is not recommended as it may increase the risk of adverse effects and does not provide additional benefits.
snippets.pattern_notes: Recommendation (not recommended) supported by reasons (risks, no benefit).

snippets.output: It is best to take losartan at the same time every day, as directed by your healthcare provider.
snippets.pattern_notes: Two parallel adherence instructions about taking losartan.
